# Results tables (generated by evaluate.py; do not edit by hand)

Train 2025-08-14 to 2026-04-30; test 2026-05-01 to 2026-08-13. Mean Brier score and binary log loss per contract (log loss clips probabilities to [1e-6, 1-1e-6]). Intervals resample whole days with replacement (1000 replicates, seed 473).

### Main comparison: test days, identical rows

Every model is scored on the same contracts: test-day contracts with a Kalshi midpoint at the cutoff and a persistence forecast.

105 days, 630 contracts, 1000 day-level bootstrap replicates. Lower is better; brackets are 95% intervals.

| Model | Days | Contracts | Brier [95% CI] | Log loss [95% CI] |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| GEFS ensemble | 105 | 630 | 0.1450 [0.1337, 0.1569] | 0.6558 [0.5371, 0.8024] |
| Climatology | 105 | 630 | 0.1685 [0.1533, 0.1823] | 0.5588 [0.5071, 0.6125] |
| Persistence | 105 | 630 | 0.1871 [0.1736, 0.2001] | 0.6193 [0.5661, 0.6743] |
| Kalshi midpoint | 105 | 630 | 0.1091 [0.1010, 0.1172] | 0.3408 [0.3168, 0.3643] |

| Difference (first − second) | Brier diff [95% CI] | Log loss diff [95% CI] | Share of replicates where first is better (Brier) |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| GEFS ensemble − Climatology | -0.0235 [-0.0408, -0.0047] | 0.0970 [-0.0424, 0.2585] | 0.993 |
| GEFS ensemble − Kalshi midpoint | 0.0358 [0.0250, 0.0479] | 0.3150 [0.1999, 0.4560] | 0.000 |
| GEFS ensemble − Persistence | -0.0421 [-0.0602, -0.0238] | 0.0364 [-0.1079, 0.1939] | 1.000 |

### Log-loss sensitivity to the probability clip (test days, identical rows)

12 of 630 test contracts resolved YES while the raw ensemble gave them probability 0 (all 31 members outside the bin). Each costs -ln(clip) in log loss, so the ensemble log loss depends on the clip. Brier scores do not change.

| Clip | GEFS ensemble | Climatology | Kalshi midpoint | Ensemble − Climatology [95% CI] |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1e-06 | 0.6558 | 0.5588 | 0.3408 | 0.0970 [-0.0424, 0.2585] |
| 0.001 | 0.5245 | 0.5588 | 0.3408 | -0.0344 [-0.1182, 0.0600] |
| 0.01 | 0.4830 | 0.5555 | 0.3409 | -0.0725 [-0.1383, 0.0008] |

### Supplement: whole window (train and test days)

The ensemble is uncorrected, climatology uses 1991–2020 and persistence uses 1991–2020 changes, so none of these is fit on 2025–26 data and every day is out of sample for them. Kept separate from the main table because the train days will be used for fitting later.

363 days, 2178 contracts, 1000 day-level bootstrap replicates. Lower is better; brackets are 95% intervals.
